# Game parameters

Every tunable value in the game, with its status:

- **approved** — a rule fixed by the design specification.
- **provisional** — a placeholder so the game can run. It is *not* an official
  rule and must be confirmed by simulations or a design decision.

All values can be overridden without a code change with a JSON file passed in
`TIO_PARAMS_FILE` (unknown keys and type changes are rejected). The live values
are served at `GET /api/params` and shown in the app under *More → Game rules*.

Approved: 23 · Provisional: 43

## gps

| Parameter | Value | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gps.maxAccuracyM` | 20 | approved | Fixes with a declared accuracy worse than this are ignored. |
| `gps.dwellMs` | 2000 | approved | Continuous time in one neutral cell needed to conquer it. |
| `gps.maxFixGapMs` | 10000 | provisional | Longest gap between fixes that still counts as continuous presence for the dwell timer. |
| `gps.freshFixMs` | 15000 | provisional | Max age of the last accepted fix for actions that need the real position (drone launch, expeditionary deployment). |
| `gps.minFixIntervalMs` | 250 | provisional | Fixes arriving faster than this are dropped (rate limit). |
| `gps.implausibleSpeedKmh` | 1200 | provisional | Implied speed between consecutive fixes above which an anomaly is logged. Any real speed is allowed; one jump is never proof. |
| `gps.anomalyWindowHours` | 24 | provisional | Rolling window for counting anomalies. |
| `gps.anomalyThreshold` | 30 | provisional | Anomalies within the window that suspend GPS conquest. |
| `gps.suspensionHours` | 12 | provisional | Length of a GPS-conquest suspension after repeated abuse. |
